@[expose] public section

open SimpleGraph

namespace Erdos548

/--
Let $n\geq k+1$. Every graph on $n$ vertices with at least $\frac{k-1}{2}n+1$ edges contains every tree on $k+1$ vertices.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5,
  formal_proof using lean4 at "https://github.com/Jayyhk/erdos-lean/blob/4c355efbf8e90c2572aa8d0c8d6f3b4b43f011f4/problems/548/Erdos548.lean#L1182"]
theorem erdos_548 (n k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 ≤ n) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (H : ((k : ℚ) - 1) / 2 * n + 1 ≤ (G.edgeSet.ncard : ℚ))
    (T : SimpleGraph (Fin (k + 1))) (hT : T.IsTree) : T.IsContained G := by
  sorry

end Erdos548

reformulations.difference: The rational lower bound e(G) ≥ (k−1)n/2 + 1 matches the cited problem website exactly. Some cited primary literature instead uses e(G) > (k−1)n/2: [Er78] uses an integer-part threshold, and [YiLi04] explicitly states the strict inequality. These hypotheses differ for a fixed graph when (k−1)n is odd, but the universally quantified conjectures are equivalent.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: The strict-threshold version immediately implies the Lean version. Conversely, integrality gives 2e(G) ≥ (k−1)n + 1 whenever e(G) > (k−1)n/2. The disjoint union of two copies of G therefore satisfies the Lean threshold on 2n vertices. A copy of the connected target tree in that union lies wholly in one summand, yielding a copy in G. This equivalence was proved without using erdos_548 in /workspace/review/equivalence.lean; its axioms are only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.

review.notes: The sole theorem faithfully states the source. Checked quantifiers, rational arithmetic, finite edge cardinality, connected acyclic trees, and non-induced containment. Lean tests confirmed finite edge counts, the harmless k = 0 singleton case, exclusion of an empty host, and a satisfiable smallest nonzero-tree instance. The archived source and current community database both record an affirmative Lean-verified solution. The exact linked external proof also kernel-checks after three API-only compatibility edits in a scratch copy, with axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; no statement or hypothesis was changed. Live erdosproblems.com access was Cloudflare-blocked. Ancillary papers with unavailable full text were checked through bibliographic records and the source's summaries; the main statement was independently verified against the original Erdős paper and the other accessible sources.
